title: Core: Replace `GetSimpleTypeT` with `std::decay_t`
body:
- Supersedes #104852

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Gives uniformity to our core logic that relies on narrowing templates to their basic types by wholly replacing `GetSimpleTypeT` (an alias for `std::remove_cv_t<std::remove_reference_t<T>>`) with the far more appropriate and less verbose `std::decay_t`.

## Additional information

Originally I thought we'd just drop this once the C++20 `std::remove_cvref_t` was a thing, but given `std::decay_t` is more appropriate to begin with, it makes more sense to make this transition now.
